done_when: You can name the tempting first read.
You can explain which lens expands the question.
You can explain which lens creates the boundary.
You can state what evidence would change confidence.
not_done_when: You only repeat the model names.
You convert the exercise into a recommendation.
You ignore the boundary or non-claim.

dominant_thinking_move: Sort the situation into buckets before deciding what each bucket needs.

answer_criteria: The first read is stated in plain language.
The answer names evidence, not vibes or status.
The answer includes a confidence-changing boundary.
exercises.common_failure_mode: The rep becomes a decision recommendation instead of reasoning practice.
exercises.prompt: Sort the situation into buckets before deciding what each bucket needs.
steps: Which category does this part belong to, and does that category need a different rule?
Name the boundary that would change confidence.
exercises.title: Sort The Case Before Judging It

answer_criteria: Each lens gets a different job.
The relation type is explained without only naming it.
The answer says what would be missed if only one lens were used.
exercises.common_failure_mode: The answer lists model names but does not explain the relation.
exercises.prompt: Cognitive Load Theory and Optionality form a structured tension pair. Cognitive Load Theory conflicts with Optionality when too many parallel branches exceed practical decision bandwidth. Use the pair as a calibration exercise: do not maximize either lens. Cognitive Load Theory protects against overload, while Optionality protects against premature closure. The lesson is to choose the smallest set of options that still preserves learning.
steps: Write one sentence for what cognitive-load-theory sees.
Write one sentence for what optionality sees.
Name why the pair is a structured_tension.
exercises.title: Explain The Model Pair

answer_criteria: The answer refuses to claim decision correctness.
The answer names a concrete missing fact or condition.
The answer keeps the model useful without making it universal.
exercises.common_failure_mode: This lesson does not prove the original answer was wrong or the revised answer was right.
exercises.prompt: Do not call this model noise or imply it was adjudicated.
steps: Name what the lesson is allowed to teach.
Name what the lesson is not allowed to claim.
Name one missing fact that would change how strongly you use the model.
exercises.title: Stop Before Fake Certainty
